## Verification checklist (must all be checked before review)

- [ ] Local formatter passed.
- [ ] Local linter passed.
- [ ] Local type check passed (TS, mypy, or go vet).
- [ ] Unit tests pass locally.
- [ ] Fixture / integration tests pass locally.
- [ ] Packaging / install smoke passes (clean environment).
- [ ] Docs quickstart commands re-verified.
- [ ] New behavior has at least one test.
- [ ] Public API / CLI surface documented in the relevant `README.md`.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] If MCP: `tools/list` is stable; new tool has a contract test.
- [ ] If skill: install instructions verified on at least one target agent.
- [ ] No secrets, no large generated files, no IDE cruft.
